data.universe: NIFTY, BANKNIFTY + NIFTY 50 stocks, last 5 sessions, 5m and 15m
data.method: Last opposite candle before a displacement that breaks the latest swing high/low (>=1 ATR beyond the block, >=1.5 ATR move). ACTIVE = price has not returned into the zone; MITIGATED = price traded back into it; BROKEN = a close through the far side.
